records.key: settings['n_jobs'] = {n_jobs!r} must be an integer number of worker processes, or None to let spaCR choose. Set n_jobs to a positive whole number, or leave it blank to choose the worker count automatically.
records.source: settings['n_jobs'] = {n_jobs!r} must be an integer number of worker processes, or None to let spaCR choose. Set n_jobs to a positive whole number, or leave it blank to choose the worker count automatically.
records.translation: settings['n_jobs'] = {n_jobs!r} 은 작업 프로세스 수를 나타내는 정수여야 하며, None 으로 설정하면 spaCR 이 선택합니다. n_jobs 를 양의 정수로 설정하거나 작업 프로세스 수를 자동으로 선택하도록 비워 두십시오.

records.key: channel_names repeats a name: {names}. Give every measured channel a distinct name in channel_names, then rerun Measure.
records.source: channel_names repeats a name: {names}. Give every measured channel a distinct name in channel_names, then rerun Measure.
records.translation: channel_names 에 중복된 이름이 있습니다: {names}. channel_names 에서 측정한 각 채널에 고유한 이름을 지정한 다음 측정을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: granularity subsample must be in (0, 1]; got {subsample}. Set profile_granularity_subsample to a number greater than 0 and at most 1, then rerun Measure.
records.source: granularity subsample must be in (0, 1]; got {subsample}. Set profile_granularity_subsample to a number greater than 0 and at most 1, then rerun Measure.
records.translation: 입도 하위 샘플링 비율은 (0, 1] 범위여야 합니다. 입력값: {subsample}. profile_granularity_subsample 을 0보다 크고 1 이하인 수로 설정한 다음 측정을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: A DNA-content histogram needs at least {minimum} nuclei with a positive DNA signal; this one has {count}. Check the DNA stain channel and nucleus masks, and measure more nuclei with a positive DNA signal before rerunning cell-cycle analysis.
records.source: A DNA-content histogram needs at least {minimum} nuclei with a positive DNA signal; this one has {count}. Check the DNA stain channel and nucleus masks, and measure more nuclei with a positive DNA signal before rerunning cell-cycle analysis.
records.translation: DNA 함량 히스토그램에는 최소 {minimum} 개의 핵이 필요하며 각 핵의 DNA 신호가 양수여야 하지만, 현재는 {count} 개입니다. DNA 염색 채널과 핵 마스크를 확인하고 DNA 신호가 양수인 핵을 더 측정한 다음 세포 주기 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: A DNA-content histogram needs at least {minimum} nuclei near its G1 and G2 peaks; this one has {count}. Check the DNA stain channel and nucleus masks, and measure enough nuclei spanning the G1 and G2 populations before rerunning cell-cycle analysis.
records.source: A DNA-content histogram needs at least {minimum} nuclei near its G1 and G2 peaks; this one has {count}. Check the DNA stain channel and nucleus masks, and measure enough nuclei spanning the G1 and G2 populations before rerunning cell-cycle analysis.
records.translation: DNA 함량 히스토그램에는 최소 {minimum} 개의 핵이 G1 및 G2 피크 근처에 있어야 하지만, 현재는 {count} 개입니다. DNA 염색 채널과 핵 마스크를 확인하고 G1 및 G2 집단을 포함하는 충분한 수의 핵을 측정한 다음 세포 주기 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: Setting: cell_cycle_gates must be two increasing positive numbers, G1/S then S/G2; got {gates!r}. Enter a positive G1/S gate smaller than the S/G2 gate, or leave cell_cycle_gates blank to fit the gates automatically.
records.source: Setting: cell_cycle_gates must be two increasing positive numbers, G1/S then S/G2; got {gates!r}. Enter a positive G1/S gate smaller than the S/G2 gate, or leave cell_cycle_gates blank to fit the gates automatically.
records.translation: 설정: cell_cycle_gates 는 증가하는 두 양수여야 하며 순서는 G1/S, S/G2 입니다. 입력값: {gates!r}. 양수인 G1/S 경곗값을 S/G2 경곗값보다 작게 입력하거나, 경곗값을 자동으로 적합하도록 cell_cycle_gates 를 비워 두십시오.

records.key: Setting: cell_cycle_fucci_channels needs two channels, the G1 reporter then the S–G2–M reporter; got {channels!r}. Set cell_cycle_fucci_channels to [G1 channel, S–G2–M channel] using two measured channel indices, then rerun cell-cycle analysis.
records.source: Setting: cell_cycle_fucci_channels needs two channels, the G1 reporter then the S–G2–M reporter; got {channels!r}. Set cell_cycle_fucci_channels to [G1 channel, S–G2–M channel] using two measured channel indices, then rerun cell-cycle analysis.
records.translation: 설정: cell_cycle_fucci_channels 에는 G1 리포터와 S–G2–M 리포터 순서로 두 채널이 필요합니다. 입력값: {channels!r}. 측정한 두 채널의 인덱스를 사용하여 cell_cycle_fucci_channels 를 [G1 채널, S–G2–M 채널]로 설정한 다음 세포 주기 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: Setting: cell_cycle_method must be one of {choices}; got {method!r}. Choose one of the listed cell_cycle_method values, then rerun cell-cycle analysis.
records.source: Setting: cell_cycle_method must be one of {choices}; got {method!r}. Choose one of the listed cell_cycle_method values, then rerun cell-cycle analysis.
records.translation: 설정: cell_cycle_method 는 {choices} 중 하나여야 합니다. 입력값: {method!r}. 나열된 cell_cycle_method 값 중 하나를 선택한 다음 세포 주기 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: Setting: viability_thresholds must be [dead, live] with a number or None for each; got {value!r}. Enter viability_thresholds as [dead, live], using a numeric threshold or None for automatic selection in each position.
records.source: Setting: viability_thresholds must be [dead, live] with a number or None for each; got {value!r}. Enter viability_thresholds as [dead, live], using a numeric threshold or None for automatic selection in each position.
records.translation: 설정: viability_thresholds 는 [dead, live] 형식이며 각 위치에 수 또는 None 이 있어야 합니다. 입력값: {value!r}. viability_thresholds 를 [dead, live]로 입력하고 각 위치에 수치 임곗값을 사용하거나 자동 선택을 위해 None 을 사용하십시오.

records.key: {count} well(s) are named both viability_negative_wells and viability_positive_wells. Assign each control well to only one of these two settings, then rerun viability analysis.
records.source: {count} well(s) are named both viability_negative_wells and viability_positive_wells. Assign each control well to only one of these two settings, then rerun viability analysis.
records.translation: {count} 개 웰이 viability_negative_wells 와 viability_positive_wells 양쪽에 지정되어 있습니다. 각 대조 웰을 이 두 설정 중 하나에만 할당한 다음 생존율 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: The plate map {path} needs a compound column (one of {compounds}) and a concentration column (one of {doses}); it has {columns}. Add a compound column and a concentration column using the listed names, save the plate map, and select it again.
records.source: The plate map {path} needs a compound column (one of {compounds}) and a concentration column (one of {doses}); it has {columns}. Add a compound column and a concentration column using the listed names, save the plate map, and select it again.
records.translation: 플레이트 배치표 {path} 에는 화합물 열({compounds} 중 하나)과 농도 열({doses} 중 하나)이 필요합니다. 현재 열: {columns}. 나열된 이름으로 화합물 열과 농도 열을 추가하고 플레이트 배치표를 저장한 다음 다시 선택하십시오.

records.key: {path}: mask shape {mask_shape} does not match the intensity shape {shape} for {stem}. Select an aligned mask and intensity image from the same field with matching pixel dimensions, then retry.
records.source: {path}: mask shape {mask_shape} does not match the intensity shape {shape} for {stem}. Select an aligned mask and intensity image from the same field with matching pixel dimensions, then retry.
records.translation: {path}: 마스크 모양 {mask_shape} 이 강도 데이터 모양 {shape} 과 일치하지 않습니다. 해당 항목: {stem}. 같은 시야에서 정렬되어 있고 픽셀 차원이 일치하는 마스크와 강도 이미지를 선택한 다음 다시 시도하십시오.

records.key: {path}: label masks cannot contain negative IDs. Re-export the labelled mask with zero background and positive object IDs, keeping it paired with the matching source images, then retry.
records.source: {path}: label masks cannot contain negative IDs. Re-export the labelled mask with zero background and positive object IDs, keeping it paired with the matching source images, then retry.
records.translation: {path}: 라벨 마스크에는 음수 IDs 가 포함될 수 없습니다. 배경을 0으로, 객체 IDs 를 양수로 지정하여 라벨 마스크를 다시 내보내고 대응하는 원본 이미지와의 짝을 유지한 다음 다시 시도하십시오.

records.key: {path}: label ID {maximum} exceeds the maximum 65535 supported by the Measure array contract. Regenerate a compatible image-and-mask project with labels in the supported range; split fields with more than 65535 objects before measuring again.
records.source: {path}: label ID {maximum} exceeds the maximum 65535 supported by the Measure array contract. Regenerate a compatible image-and-mask project with labels in the supported range; split fields with more than 65535 objects before measuring again.
records.translation: {path}: 라벨 ID {maximum} 이 측정의 배열 형식에서 지원하는 최댓값 65535를 초과합니다. 지원 범위 안의 라벨을 사용하는 호환 가능한 이미지 및 마스크 프로젝트를 다시 생성하십시오. 다시 측정하기 전에 객체가 65535개를 초과하는 시야를 나누십시오.

records.key: settings['{name}'] = {value!r} must be a finite number > 0 (a physical size in micrometres). Enter the recorded microscope voxel size in micrometres for this setting, then run Measure again.
records.source: settings['{name}'] = {value!r} must be a finite number > 0 (a physical size in micrometres). Enter the recorded microscope voxel size in micrometres for this setting, then run Measure again.
records.translation: settings['{name}'] = {value!r} 은 유한한 수이며 > 0 이어야 합니다(마이크로미터 단위의 물리적 크기). 이 설정에 기록된 현미경 복셀 크기를 마이크로미터 단위로 입력한 다음 측정을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: settings['anisotropy'] = {value!r} must be a finite number > 0; it is the ratio dz / dxy. Set anisotropy to the recorded Z step divided by the XY pixel size, then run Measure again.
records.source: settings['anisotropy'] = {value!r} must be a finite number > 0; it is the ratio dz / dxy. Set anisotropy to the recorded Z step divided by the XY pixel size, then run Measure again.
records.translation: settings['anisotropy'] = {value!r} 은 유한한 수이며 > 0 이어야 합니다. 이는 dz / dxy 비율입니다. anisotropy 를 기록된 Z 간격을 XY 픽셀 크기로 나눈 값으로 설정한 다음 측정을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: Setting: confluency_channel is {channel}, but the merged array has {planes} planes. Choose confluency_channel from the merged-array intensity planes, using zero-based indices, then rerun Measure.
records.source: Setting: confluency_channel is {channel}, but the merged array has {planes} planes. Choose confluency_channel from the merged-array intensity planes, using zero-based indices, then rerun Measure.
records.translation: 설정: confluency_channel 은 {channel} 이지만 병합된 배열에는 {planes} 개 평면이 있습니다. 0부터 시작하는 인덱스를 사용하여 병합된 배열의 강도 평면 중에서 confluency_channel 을 선택한 다음 측정을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: Setting: cell_cycle_gates must be two numbers in DNA content units, such as [2.5, 3.5]; got {gates!r}. Enter [G1/S, S/G2] in cell_cycle_gates, or leave it blank to fit the gates automatically.
records.source: Setting: cell_cycle_gates must be two numbers in DNA content units, such as [2.5, 3.5]; got {gates!r}. Enter [G1/S, S/G2] in cell_cycle_gates, or leave it blank to fit the gates automatically.
records.translation: 설정: cell_cycle_gates 는 DNA 함량 단위의 두 수여야 하며, 예를 들면 [2.5, 3.5] 입니다. 입력값: {gates!r}. [G1/S, S/G2] 를 cell_cycle_gates 에 입력하거나 경곗값을 자동으로 적합하도록 비워 두십시오.

records.key: {db_path} has no nucleus or cell table; live/dead calls are made on measured nuclei or cells. Measure cell or nucleus masks first by setting cell_mask_dim or nucleus_mask_dim, then rerun viability analysis.
records.source: {db_path} has no nucleus or cell table; live/dead calls are made on measured nuclei or cells. Measure cell or nucleus masks first by setting cell_mask_dim or nucleus_mask_dim, then rerun viability analysis.
records.translation: {db_path} 에 핵 테이블이나 세포 테이블이 없습니다. 생존 및 사멸 판정은 측정된 핵이나 세포를 대상으로 합니다. 먼저 cell_mask_dim 또는 nucleus_mask_dim 을 설정하여 세포 마스크나 핵 마스크를 측정한 다음 생존율 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: {path}: {stem} intensity data contain NaN or infinity. Correct the source image export so every intensity is finite, then select the corrected file in the measurement table.
records.source: {path}: {stem} intensity data contain NaN or infinity. Correct the source image export so every intensity is finite, then select the corrected file in the measurement table.
records.translation: {path}: {stem} 의 강도 데이터에 NaN 또는 무한대가 포함되어 있습니다. 모든 강도가 유한한 값이 되도록 원본 이미지 내보내기를 수정한 다음 측정 테이블에서 수정된 파일을 선택하십시오.

records.key: label plane {plane} holds object id {top:g}, which does not fit the Measure uint16 working array; labels are not clipped or renumbered. Regenerate a compatible image-and-mask project with labels in the supported range; split fields with more than 65535 objects before measuring again.
records.source: label plane {plane} holds object id {top:g}, which does not fit the Measure uint16 working array; labels are not clipped or renumbered. Regenerate a compatible image-and-mask project with labels in the supported range; split fields with more than 65535 objects before measuring again.
records.translation: 라벨 평면 {plane} 에 객체 식별자 {top:g} 가 있으며, 이는 측정의 uint16 작업 배열에 들어가지 않습니다. 라벨은 잘리거나 다시 번호가 매겨지지 않습니다. 지원 범위 안의 라벨을 사용하는 호환 가능한 이미지 및 마스크 프로젝트를 다시 생성하고, 다시 측정하기 전에 객체가 65535개를 초과하는 시야를 나누십시오.

records.key: Setting: wound_conditions[{name!r}]: {exc}. Use well names such as B03, row tokens such as r2, or column tokens such as c3 in this condition, then retry.
records.source: Setting: wound_conditions[{name!r}]: {exc}. Use well names such as B03, row tokens such as r2, or column tokens such as c3 in this condition, then retry.
records.translation: 설정: wound_conditions[{name!r}]: {exc}. 이 조건에는 B03 같은 웰 이름, r2 같은 행 토큰 또는 c3 같은 열 토큰을 사용한 다음 다시 시도하십시오.

records.key: Setting: wound_conditions puts one well in both {previous!r} and {name!r}; a well can belong to one condition only. Remove the overlapping well from one condition in wound_conditions, then retry.
records.source: Setting: wound_conditions puts one well in both {previous!r} and {name!r}; a well can belong to one condition only. Remove the overlapping well from one condition in wound_conditions, then retry.
records.translation: 설정: wound_conditions 가 하나의 웰을 {previous!r} 및 {name!r} 양쪽에 배치합니다. 웰은 하나의 조건에만 속할 수 있습니다. wound_conditions 에서 중복된 웰을 한 조건에서 제거한 다음 다시 시도하십시오.

records.key: Setting: viability_thresholds entries must be numbers or None; got {item!r}. Replace the invalid entry with a numeric threshold or None for automatic selection, then rerun viability analysis.
records.source: Setting: viability_thresholds entries must be numbers or None; got {item!r}. Replace the invalid entry with a numeric threshold or None for automatic selection, then rerun viability analysis.
records.translation: 설정: viability_thresholds 항목은 수 또는 None 이어야 합니다. 입력값: {item!r}. 잘못된 항목을 수치 임곗값으로 바꾸거나 자동 선택을 위해 None 을 사용한 다음 생존율 분석을 다시 실행하십시오.

records.key: {path}: channel {channel} of {stem} has shape {channel_shape}, but channel 1 has {shape}. Select aligned channel images from the same field with matching pixel dimensions, then retry.
records.source: {path}: channel {channel} of {stem} has shape {channel_shape}, but channel 1 has {shape}. Select aligned channel images from the same field with matching pixel dimensions, then retry.
records.translation: {path}: 채널 {channel}, 해당 항목 {stem} 의 모양은 {channel_shape} 이지만 채널 1의 모양은 {shape} 입니다. 같은 시야에서 정렬되어 있고 픽셀 차원이 일치하는 채널 이미지를 선택한 다음 다시 시도하십시오.

review_kind: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-19 of the spaCR error-message batches 4-5 recovery steps (25 Measure messages). No human or native-speaker signoff.
